description: Defines the WASAPIAudioDevice class for managing UWP WASAPI audio devices, including methods for retrieving cached device info and passthrough support, along with internal initialization and COM interface handling.

classes.name: WASAPIAudioDevice
classes.description: Manages UWP WASAPI audio device interactions, including caching device info and support for specific audio codecs.

methods.name: GetCachedBitrateOfDefaultAudioRenderer
methods.description: Returns cached bitrate of the default audio renderer.

methods.name: GetCachedNumChannelsOfDefaultAudioRenderer
methods.description: Returns cached number of channels of the default audio renderer.

methods.name: GetPassthroughSupportOfDefaultAudioRenderer
methods.description: Checks if passthrough support for a specific audio codec is available on the default renderer.

methods.name: WASAPIAudioDevice
methods.description: Constructor for the audio device class.

methods.name: ~WASAPIAudioDevice
methods.description: Destructor for the audio device class.

methods.name: GetNumChannels
methods.description: Returns the number of audio channels.

methods.name: GetBitrate
methods.description: Returns the bitrate of the audio device.

methods.name: GetPassthroughCodecSupport
methods.description: Checks support for specific audio codecs (AC3, EAC3).

methods.name: ActivateCompleted
methods.description: Handles completion of audio interface activation.
